full 27-repo SEED_PANEL + 1 extra (mlabonne/Qwen3-4B-abliterated).

Everything that touches `transformers` runs in this ONE long-lived process
per the workspace's performance warning (MooseFS cold-import tax).

Outputs (under <WS>/build/):
  tokens_refusal_onset.json
  tokens_hedge_redirect.json
  tokens_matched_control.json
  tokenizer_table.json
  mining_stats.json   (everything tokens_report.md needs, incl. all 5 gates)
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import json
import re
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from loguru import logger

WS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
BUILD = WS / "build"
LOGS = WS / "logs"
JUDGED_DIR = Path(
    "/ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_YqmEFECOIR3D/3_invention_loop/iter_1/"
    "gen_art/gen_art_experiment_3/results/judged"
)
LC_PANEL_PY = Path(
    "/ai-inventor/aii_data/runs/run_YqmEFECOIR3D/3_invention_loop/iter_1/"
    "gen_art/gen_art_experiment_3/lc_panel.py"
)
DNA_PATH = WS / "temp" / "datasets" / "full_do_not_answer.json"

REFERENCE_TOKENIZER_REPO = "Qwen/Qwen3-4B"
EXTRA_TOKENIZER_REPOS = ["mlabonne/Qwen3-4B-abliterated"]  # Qwen3-4B/SafeRL already in panel

PREFERRED_HEDGE_SLUGS = {
    "Qwen__Qwen3-4B": (0.4444, 0.0000),
    "Damien420__granite-3.2-2b-instruct-abliterated": (0.5778, 0.0000),
    "microsoft__Phi-4-mini-instruct": (0.6591, 0.0000),
}
COMPLIANT_CONTRAST_SLUGS = {
    "TinyLlama__TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0": 0.6444,
    "huihui-ai__Huihui-Qwen3-1.7B-abliterated-v2": 0.6667,
}

NAIVE_COMPARATOR = [
    "I'm sorry", "I cannot", "I can't", "Sorry", "As an AI",
    "I'm unable", "I won't", "Unfortunately", "I apologize",
]

WORD_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z']*")
LEADING_WORD_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*([A-Za-z][A-Za-z']*)")

G_HEDGE_LIFT_THRESHOLD = 2.0
G_CONTROL_CALIPER = 0.25
G_SINGLE_TOKEN_COVERAGE = 0.80
G_XSRC_JACCARD_THRESHOLD = 0.20
MIN_FORMS = 20
MIN_FAMILIES = 3


def setup_logging() -> None:
    logger.remove()
    logger.add(sys.stdout, level="INFO", format="{time:HH:mm:ss}|{level:<7}|{message}")
    LOGS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    logger.add(LOGS / "tokens.log", rotation="30 MB", level="DEBUG")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. SEED_PANEL parsing (no execution of lc_panel.py -> AST literal_eval only)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def parse_seed_panel(path: Path) -> tuple[dict[str, list[str]], dict[str, str]]:
    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
    panel = None
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(
            getattr(t, "id", None) == "SEED_PANEL" for t in node.targets
        ):
            panel = ast.literal_eval(node.value)
            break
    if panel is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"SEED_PANEL not found in {path}")
    family_to_repos = {fam: [r[0] for r in lst] for fam, lst in panel.items()}
    slug_to_family = {}
    for fam, lst in panel.items():
        for repo_id, _role, _rf in lst:
            slug_to_family[repo_id.replace("/", "__")] = fam
    return family_to_repos, slug_to_family


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Judged generations: load + classify into the 3 (+1) generation classes
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def load_judged(judged_dir: Path, slug_to_family: dict[str, str]) -> list[dict]:
    rows: list[dict] = []
    n_null_judge = 0
    files = sorted(judged_dir.glob("*.jsonl"))
    for fp in files:
        for line in fp.read_text().splitlines():
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            r = json.loads(line)
            if r.get("judge_primary") is None:
                n_null_judge += 1
                continue
            r["family"] = slug_to_family.get(r["slug"], "UNKNOWN")
            rows.append(r)
    logger.info(
        f"loaded {len(rows)} judged rows from {len(files)} files "
        f"({n_null_judge} dropped for null judge_primary)"
    )
    unknown = sorted({r["slug"] for r in rows if r["family"] == "UNKNOWN"})
    if unknown:
        logger.warning(f"{len(unknown)} slugs not found in SEED_PANEL family map: {unknown}")
    return rows


def classify_rows(rows: list[dict]) -> dict[str, list[dict]]:
    """Explicit, documented 4-way partition of judged generations.

    - REFUSING           : judge_primary.refused == True                       (any set)
    - SAFE-DECLINE        : refused==False AND harmful_content==False AND set=='harm'
                            (declines a harmful ask without lexical refusal; on_topic_help
                            is recorded per-row since it is diagnostic here)
    - ORDINARY-HELPFUL    : refused==False AND harmful_content==False AND set=='benign'
                            (the model actually helps with a benign ask -- this is the
                            control-frequency baseline corpus)
    - HARMFUL-COMPLIANT   : refused==False AND harmful_content==True (harm set, almost
                            always) -- a 4th class, excluded from all three artefacts
                            (its vocabulary is topically contaminated with harm content
                            and is not a "neutral" control baseline), but counted/reported
                            for transparency.
    We do NOT apply the raw (refused==False AND harmful_content==False) boolean pair to
    BOTH sets identically: on the benign set that pair is simply normal helpfulness, not
    a "decline", so SAFE-DECLINE is scoped to set=='harm' and ORDINARY-HELPFUL to
    set=='benign'. This is documented explicitly per the task's instruction to define it.
    """
    buckets: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
    for r in rows:
        jp = r["judge_primary"]
        if jp["refused"]:
            buckets["REFUSING"].append(r)
        elif not jp["harmful_content"] and r["set"] == "harm":
            buckets["SAFE_DECLINE"].append(r)
        elif not jp["harmful_content"] and r["set"] == "benign":
            buckets["ORDINARY_HELPFUL"].append(r)
        elif jp["harmful_content"]:
            buckets["HARMFUL_COMPLIANT"].append(r)
        else:
            buckets["OTHER"].append(r)
    for k, v in buckets.items():
        logger.info(f"class {k}: {len(v)} rows")
    return buckets


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# helpers
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def word_ngrams(text: str, n: int) -> str | None:
    words = text.strip().split()
    if len(words) < n:
        return None
    return " ".join(words[:n])


def normalize_ws(s: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s.strip())


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Artefact 3a: refusal-onset set
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def mine_refusal_onset(
    refusing_rows: list[dict], tokenizer, slug_to_family: dict[str, str]
) -> tuple[list[dict], dict]:
    logger.info(f"mining refusal-onset forms from {len(refusing_rows)} REFUSING generations")
    # candidate -> (level, set of (slug,gt_id) generation keys)
    cand_gens: dict[tuple[str, str], set[tuple[str, str]]] = defaultdict(set)
    for r in refusing_rows:
        text = r["response"]
        gen_key = (r["slug"], r["gt_id"])
        # tokenizer-based first-token surface form
        ids = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
        if ids:
            first_piece = tokenizer.convert_ids_to_tokens([ids[0]])[0]
            surface = tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_string([first_piece]).strip()
            if surface:
                cand_gens[(surface, "qwen3_first_token")].add(gen_key)
        # surface n-grams, tokenizer-independent
        for n in (1, 2, 3):
            ng = word_ngrams(text, n)
            if ng:
                cand_gens[(ng, f"surface_ngram_{n}")].add(gen_key)

    total_by_form: dict[str, tuple[str, set]] = {}
    for (form, level), gens in cand_gens.items():
        # priority: prefer the token-level tag if the identical string also arose
        # at word1 level (keeps one row per distinct surface string)
        if form in total_by_form:
            prev_level, prev_gens = total_by_form[form][0], total_by_form[form][1]
            level_priority = {"qwen3_first_token": 0, "surface_ngram_1": 1,
                               "surface_ngram_2": 2, "surface_ngram_3": 3}
            if level_priority[level] < level_priority[prev_level]:
                total_by_form[form] = (level, gens | prev_gens)
            else:
                total_by_form[form] = (prev_level, prev_gens | gens)
        else:
            total_by_form[form] = (level, gens)

    records = []
    for form, (level, gens) in total_by_form.items():
        families = {slug_to_family.get(slug, "UNKNOWN") for slug, _ in gens}
        records.append({
            "form": form,
            "level": level,
            "n_refusing_generations_opened": len(gens),
            "n_families": len(families),
            "families": sorted(families),
        })
    # gate: family coverage >= 3
    passing = [r for r in records if r["n_families"] >= MIN_FAMILIES]
    passing.sort(key=lambda r: (-r["n_refusing_generations_opened"], r["form"]))
    shipped = passing[:60]
    for i, r in enumerate(shipped, start=1):
        r["rank"] = i

    n_dropped_family = len(records) - len(passing)
    stats = {
        "n_candidates_total": len(records),
        "n_dropped_family_coverage_lt_3": n_dropped_family,
        "n_shipped": len(shipped),
        "gate_G_REFUSAL_FORMS": {
            "threshold": f">= {MIN_FORMS} forms with n_families >= {MIN_FAMILIES}",
            "observed_n_forms": len(shipped),
            "observed_min_families_among_shipped": min((r["n_families"] for r in shipped), default=0),
            "pass": len(shipped) >= MIN_FORMS,
        },
    }
    logger.info(
        f"refusal-onset: {len(records)} candidates -> {len(passing)} pass family>=3 "
        f"-> shipping {len(shipped)}; gate PASS={stats['gate_G_REFUSAL_FORMS']['pass']}"
    )
    return shipped, stats


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Artefact 3b: hedge-and-redirect set
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def doc_ngram_counts(rows: list[dict], n_max: int = 3) -> tuple[Counter, int]:
    """Distinct-DOCUMENT n-gram counts (1..n_max words), lowercase."""
    counts: Counter = Counter()
    for r in rows:
        text = r["response"].lower()
        words = WORD_RE.findall(text)
        seen_in_doc: set[str] = set()
        for n in range(1, n_max + 1):
            for i in range(0, max(0, len(words) - n + 1)):
                ng = " ".join(words[i:i + n])
                seen_in_doc.add(ng)
        counts.update(seen_in_doc)
    return counts, len(rows)


def mine_hedge_redirect(
    safe_decline_rows: list[dict],
    ordinary_rows: list[dict],
    refusal_onset_forms: set[str],
) -> tuple[list[dict], dict]:
    preferred_rows = [r for r in safe_decline_rows if r["slug"] in PREFERRED_HEDGE_SLUGS]
    logger.info(
        f"hedge-redirect: {len(safe_decline_rows)} SAFE_DECLINE rows total, "
        f"{len(preferred_rows)} from the 3 preferred high-refusal/low-harmful checkpoints "
        f"{sorted(PREFERRED_HEDGE_SLUGS)}"
    )
    contrast_rows = [r for r in safe_decline_rows if r["slug"] in COMPLIANT_CONTRAST_SLUGS]
    logger.info(
        f"contrast (compliant) checkpoints {sorted(COMPLIANT_CONTRAST_SLUGS)} contribute "
        f"only {len(contrast_rows)} SAFE_DECLINE rows (they rarely safe-decline -- they "
        f"mostly either refuse outright or comply harmfully instead)"
    )

    oh_counts, n_oh = doc_ngram_counts(ordinary_rows, n_max=3)
    logger.info(f"ordinary-helpful (benign, refused=F harmful=F) corpus: {n_oh} documents")

    def build_candidates(pool_rows: list[dict], pool_name: str) -> list[dict]:
        sd_counts, n_sd = doc_ngram_counts(pool_rows, n_max=3)
        out = []
        for form, count_sd in sd_counts.items():
            if count_sd < 2:
                continue
            if form in refusal_onset_forms:
                continue
            count_oh = oh_counts.get(form, 0)
            rate_sd = count_sd / n_sd
            rate_oh = (count_oh + 0.5) / (n_oh + 1)  # Haldane-Anscombe continuity correction
            lift = rate_sd / rate_oh
            if lift >= G_HEDGE_LIFT_THRESHOLD:
                out.append({
                    "form": form,
                    "n_words": len(form.split()),
                    "count_safe_decline": count_sd,
                    "n_safe_decline_docs_in_pool": n_sd,
                    "count_ordinary_helpful": count_oh,
                    "n_ordinary_helpful_docs": n_oh,
                    "lift": round(lift, 3),
                    "source_pool": pool_name,
                })
        return out

    cands = build_candidates(preferred_rows, "preferred_checkpoints")
    used_fallback = False
    if len(cands) < MIN_FORMS:
        logger.warning(
            f"only {len(cands)} preferred-checkpoint candidates passed lift>={G_HEDGE_LIFT_THRESHOLD} "
            f"-> falling back to the FULL panel SAFE_DECLINE pool as documented"
        )
        used_fallback = True
        fallback_cands = build_candidates(safe_decline_rows, "full_panel_fallback")
        seen_forms = {c["form"] for c in cands}
        for c in fallback_cands:
            if c["form"] not in seen_forms:
                cands.append(c)
                seen_forms.add(c["form"])

    cands.sort(key=lambda c: (-c["count_safe_decline"], -c["lift"], c["form"]))
    shipped = cands[:60]
    for i, r in enumerate(shipped, start=1):
        r["rank"] = i

    stats = {
        "n_preferred_pool_docs": len(preferred_rows),
        "n_full_panel_pool_docs": len(safe_decline_rows),
        "n_contrast_compliant_pool_docs": len(contrast_rows),
        "used_full_panel_fallback": used_fallback,
        "n_candidates_passing_lift": len(cands),
        "n_shipped": len(shipped),
        "gate_G_HEDGE_FORMS": {
            "threshold": f">= {MIN_FORMS} forms with lift >= {G_HEDGE_LIFT_THRESHOLD}",
            "observed_n_forms": len(shipped),
            "pass": len(shipped) >= MIN_FORMS,
        },
    }
    logger.info(f"hedge-redirect: shipping {len(shipped)}; gate PASS={stats['gate_G_HEDGE_FORMS']['pass']}")
    return shipped, stats


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Naive comparator
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def naive_comparator_stats(refusing_rows: list[dict], mined_forms: list[str]) -> dict:
    def covered_by(strings: list[str], case_insensitive: bool) -> set[tuple[str, str]]:
        covered = set()
        for r in refusing_rows:
            text = normalize_ws(r["response"])
            hay = text.lower() if case_insensitive else text
            for s in strings:
                needle = s.lower() if case_insensitive else s
                if hay.startswith(needle):
                    covered.add((r["slug"], r["gt_id"]))
                    break
        return covered

    naive_covered = covered_by(NAIVE_COMPARATOR, case_insensitive=True)
    mined_covered = covered_by(mined_forms, case_insensitive=False)
    total = len(refusing_rows)
    return {
        "naive_comparator_list": NAIVE_COMPARATOR,
        "naive_comparator_label": "CONSTRUCTED (obvious guess, not mined)",
        "n_total_refusing_generations": total,
        "n_opened_by_naive_comparator": len(naive_covered),
        "frac_opened_by_naive_comparator": round(len(naive_covered) / total, 4) if total else None,
        "n_opened_by_mined_set": len(mined_covered),
        "frac_opened_by_mined_set": round(len(mined_covered) / total, 4) if total else None,
    }


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Tokenizer loading (ONE process, full 28-repo set)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def load_all_tokenizers(repos: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    from transformers import AutoTokenizer

    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for i, repo in enumerate(repos, start=1):
        try:
            tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(repo, trust_remote_code=True)
            out[repo] = {"tokenizer": tok, "error": None, "tokenizer_verified": True}
            logger.info(f"[{i}/{len(repos)}] loaded tokenizer OK: {repo} (vocab={tok.vocab_size})")
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - must record, not crash the whole run
            out[repo] = {"tokenizer": None, "error": f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}", "tokenizer_verified": False}
            logger.error(f"[{i}/{len(repos)}] FAILED to load tokenizer: {repo}: {e}")
    return out


def encode_variant(tok, form: str, leading_space: bool) -> dict:
    text = (" " + form) if leading_space else form
    ids = tok.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
    n_pieces = len(ids)
    try:
        decoded = tok.decode(ids)
    except Exception:
        decoded = None
    roundtrip = (decoded is not None) and (decoded.strip() == form.strip())
    return {
        "ids": ids,
        "n_pieces": n_pieces,
        "is_single_token": n_pieces == 1,
        "exact_surface_roundtrip": roundtrip,
    }


def build_tokenizer_table(all_forms: list[str], tokenizers: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict, dict]:
    table: dict[str, Any] = {}
    single_token_frac_midtext: dict[str, float] = {}
    n_verified = sum(1 for v in tokenizers.values() if v["tokenizer_verified"])
    logger.info(f"building compatibility table: {len(all_forms)} forms x {len(tokenizers)} tokenizers x 2 variants")
    for form in all_forms:
        per_tok = {}
        n_single_mid = 0
        n_pieces_mid_set = set()
        for repo, info in tokenizers.items():
            if not info["tokenizer_verified"]:
                per_tok[repo] = {"tokenizer_verified": False, "error": info["error"]}
                continue
            tok = info["tokenizer"]
            mid = encode_variant(tok, form, leading_space=True)
            init = encode_variant(tok, form, leading_space=False)
            per_tok[repo] = {"tokenizer_verified": True, "mid_text": mid, "turn_initial": init}
            if mid["is_single_token"]:
                n_single_mid += 1
            n_pieces_mid_set.add(mid["n_pieces"])
        frac = n_single_mid / n_verified if n_verified else 0.0
        single_token_frac_midtext[form] = frac
        table[form] = {
            "per_tokenizer": per_tok,
            "n_single_token_mid_text": n_single_mid,
            "n_tokenizers_verified": n_verified,
            "frac_single_token_mid_text": round(frac, 4),
            "segmentation_disagreement_flag": len(n_pieces_mid_set) > 1,
        }
    return table, single_token_frac_midtext


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Matched control set (Artefact 3c)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def full_corpus_word_freq(all_rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[Counter, int]:
    counts: Counter = Counter()
    total = 0
    for r in all_rows:
        words = WORD_RE.findall(r["response"].lower())
        counts.update(words)
        total += len(words)
    return counts, total


def build_matched_control(
    selected_tokens: list[dict],
    ordinary_rows: list[dict],
    all_rows: list[dict],
    ref_tok,
    tokenizers: dict[str, Any],
) -> tuple[list[dict], dict]:
    full_counts, full_total = full_corpus_word_freq(all_rows)

    def log_freq(w: str) -> float:
        c = full_counts.get(w.lower(), 0)
        c_eff = c if c > 0 else 0.5  # continuity floor for absent/rare surface forms
        import math
        return math.log10(c_eff / full_total)

    # candidate pool: top-N most frequent ORDINARY-HELPFUL word types
    oh_counts = Counter()
    for r in ordinary_rows:
        oh_counts.update(set(WORD_RE.findall(r["response"].lower())))
    selected_set = {t["surface"].lower() for t in selected_tokens}
    naive_set = {s.lower() for s in " ".join(NAIVE_COMPARATOR).split()}
    pool_words = [
        w for w, _ in oh_counts.most_common(1500)
        if w not in selected_set and w not in naive_set and len(w) >= 2
    ]
    pool_words = pool_words[:500]
    logger.info(f"matched-control candidate pool: {len(pool_words)} distinct ordinary-helpful word types")

    n_verified = sum(1 for v in tokenizers.values() if v["tokenizer_verified"])

    def single_token_count(w: str) -> int:
        n = 0
        for repo, info in tokenizers.items():
            if not info["tokenizer_verified"]:
                continue
            ids = info["tokenizer"].encode(" " + w, add_special_tokens=False)
            if len(ids) == 1:
                n += 1
        return n

    logger.info("computing single-token-count vectors for selected tokens + control pool "
                f"({len(selected_tokens)} + {len(pool_words)} words x {n_verified} tokenizers)...")
    selected_stc = {t["surface"]: single_token_count(t["surface"]) for t in selected_tokens}
    pool_stc = {w: single_token_count(w) for w in pool_words}

    used: set[str] = set()
    matches = []
    unmatched = []
    relax_ladder = [0, 1, 2, 4, 999]  # 999 = drop single-token-count constraint entirely
    for t in selected_tokens:
        surf = t["surface"]
        target_log = log_freq(surf)
        target_len = len(surf)
        target_stc = selected_stc[surf]
        best = None
        best_relax = None
        for relax in relax_ladder:
            candidates = [
                w for w in pool_words
                if w not in used
                and abs(len(w) - target_len) <= 1
                and abs(pool_stc[w] - target_stc) <= relax
            ]
            if not candidates:
                continue
            best_w = min(candidates, key=lambda w: abs(log_freq(w) - target_log))
            diff = abs(log_freq(best_w) - target_log)
            if diff <= G_CONTROL_CALIPER:
                best = best_w
                best_relax = relax
                break
        if best is None:
            unmatched.append({"surface": surf, "level": t["level"], "artefact_source": t["artefact_source"]})
            continue
        used.add(best)
        matches.append({
            "selected_token": surf,
            "selected_level": t["level"],
            "selected_artefact_source": t["artefact_source"],
            "control_token": best,
            "selected_log_freq": round(target_log, 4),
            "control_log_freq": round(log_freq(best), 4),
            "abs_delta_log_freq": round(abs(log_freq(best) - target_log), 4),
            "selected_char_len": target_len,
            "control_char_len": len(best),
            "selected_single_token_count_of_28": target_stc,
            "control_single_token_count_of_28": pool_stc[best],
            "single_token_relaxation_used": best_relax,
        })

    deltas = [m["abs_delta_log_freq"] for m in matches]
    import statistics
    balance = {
        "n_selected": len(selected_tokens),
        "n_matched": len(matches),
        "n_unmatched": len(unmatched),
        "unmatched": unmatched,
        "median_abs_delta_log_freq": round(statistics.median(deltas), 4) if deltas else None,
        "max_abs_delta_log_freq": round(max(deltas), 4) if deltas else None,
        "caliper": G_CONTROL_CALIPER,
        "gate_G_CONTROL_BALANCE": {
            "threshold": f"median |delta log-freq| <= {G_CONTROL_CALIPER}",
            "observed_median": round(statistics.median(deltas), 4) if deltas else None,
            "pass": (statistics.median(deltas) <= G_CONTROL_CALIPER) if deltas else False,
        },
    }
    logger.info(
        f"matched control: {len(matches)}/{len(selected_tokens)} matched, "
        f"median|d|={balance['median_abs_delta_log_freq']}, max|d|={balance['max_abs_delta_log_freq']}, "
        f"gate PASS={balance['gate_G_CONTROL_BALANCE']['pass']}"
    )
    return matches, balance


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Cross-source Jaccard (G_XSRC_JACCARD)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def mine_dna_refusal_onset_top30(dna_rows: list[dict], ref_tok) -> list[str]:
    models = ["GPT4", "ChatGPT", "Claude", "ChatGLM2", "llama2-7b-chat", "vicuna-7b"]
    cand_gens: dict[str, set[tuple[int, str]]] = defaultdict(set)
    n_refusals = 0
    for row in dna_rows:
        for m in models:
            if row.get(f"{m}_action") != 0:  # verified taxonomy code 0 = explicit refusal
                continue
            text = row.get(f"{m}_response") or ""
            if not text.strip():
                continue
            n_refusals += 1
            gen_key = (row["id"], m)
            ids = ref_tok.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
            if ids:
                first_piece = ref_tok.convert_ids_to_tokens([ids[0]])[0]
                surface = ref_tok.convert_tokens_to_string([first_piece]).strip().lower()
                if surface:
                    cand_gens[surface].add(gen_key)
            for n in (1, 2, 3):
                ng = word_ngrams(text, n)
                if ng:
                    cand_gens[ng.lower()].add(gen_key)
    ranked = sorted(cand_gens.items(), key=lambda kv: -len(kv[1]))
    logger.info(f"do-not-answer: {n_refusals} action==0 real refusals across 6 models; "
                f"{len(ranked)} candidate onset forms mined")
    return [form for form, _ in ranked[:30]]


def jaccard(a: set, b: set) -> float:
    if not a and not b:
        return 0.0
    return len(a & b) / len(a | b)


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# main
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main() -> None:
    setup_logging()
    logger.info("=== ARTEFACT 3 + 6 builder starting ===")
    BUILD.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    family_to_repos, slug_to_family = parse_seed_panel(LC_PANEL_PY)
    n_repos = sum(len(v) for v in family_to_repos.values())
    logger.info(f"SEED_PANEL: {len(family_to_repos)} families, {n_repos} repos")

    onset_records, onset_stats = mine_refusal_onset(buckets["REFUSING"], ref_tok, slug_to_family)

        buckets["SAFE_DECLINE"], buckets["ORDINARY_HELPFUL"], onset_form_set
    )

    naive_stats = naive_comparator_stats(buckets["REFUSING"], [r["form"] for r in onset_records])

    # --- Artefact 6: load all panel tokenizers (ONE process) ---
    all_repos = [r for lst in family_to_repos.values() for r in lst] + EXTRA_TOKENIZER_REPOS
    logger.info(f"loading {len(all_repos)} tokenizers (27 panel + {len(EXTRA_TOKENIZER_REPOS)} extra) ...")
    t0 = time.time()
    tokenizers = load_all_tokenizers(all_repos)
    n_ok = sum(1 for v in tokenizers.values() if v["tokenizer_verified"])
    n_fail = len(tokenizers) - n_ok
    logger.info(f"tokenizer load pass: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s, {n_ok} OK / {n_fail} FAILED")

    # --- Artefact 3c: matched control ---
    selected_tokens = []
    for r in onset_records:
        if r["level"] == "qwen3_first_token":
            ids = ref_tok.encode(" " + r["form"], add_special_tokens=False)
            if len(ids) == 1:
                selected_tokens.append({"surface": r["form"], "level": "onset_token", "artefact_source": "3a"})
    for r in hedge_records:
        if r["n_words"] == 1:

    )

    gate_single_token = {

        "n_primary_forms": len(primary_forms),
        "n_dropped": len(dropped_primary),
        "dropped_forms": dropped_primary,
        "pass": len(dropped_primary) == 0,
    }

        f"G_SINGLE_TOKEN: {len(primary_forms) - len(dropped_primary)}/{len(primary_forms)} primary forms "

        "n_shipped": len(hedge_records),
        "forms": hedge_records,
        "stats": hedge_stats,
    }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

    (BUILD / "tokens_matched_control.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "description": "Artefact 3c: one control token per selected single-token-shaped "
                        "refusal/hedge form, drawn from the ORDINARY-HELPFUL (benign, "
                        "refused=False, harmful_content=False) token distribution, matched "
                        "greedy-NN without replacement on (i) log corpus frequency (full "
                        "2,370-response judged corpus, caliper 0.25 log units), (ii) character "
                        "length +/-1, (iii) single-token status across the same 28-tokenizer panel.",
        "matches": control_matches,
        "achieved_balance": control_balance,
    }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

    (BUILD / "tokenizer_table.json").write_text(json.dumps({
        "description": "Artefact 6: tokenizer compatibility table for every surface form in "
                        "3a+3b+3c across the 27-repo SEED_PANEL + mlabonne/Qwen3-4B-abliterated "
                        "(28 tokenizers), both MID-TEXT (PRIMARY, leading space) and TURN-INITIAL "
                        "(no leading space) variants.",
        "tokenizers_attempted": all_repos,
        "n_tokenizers_verified": n_ok,
        "n_tokenizers_failed": n_fail,
        "tokenizer_load_failures": {
            repo: info["error"] for repo, info in tokenizers.items() if not info["tokenizer_verified"]
        },
        "gate_G_SINGLE_TOKEN": gate_single_token,
        "n_forms": len(all_forms),
        "table": tok_table,
    }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))

    mining_stats = {
        "seed_panel": {"n_families": len(family_to_repos), "n_repos": n_repos, "families": sorted(family_to_repos)},
        "judged_source": {
            "dir": str(JUDGED_DIR), "n_files": len(list(JUDGED_DIR.glob('*.jsonl'))),
            "n_rows_loaded": len(rows),
        },
        "generation_class_counts": {k: len(v) for k, v in buckets.items()},
        "class_definitions": (
            "REFUSING=refused==True (any set); "
            "SAFE_DECLINE=refused==False & harmful_content==False & set=='harm'; "
            "ORDINARY_HELPFUL=refused==False & harmful_content==False & set=='benign' "
            "(this is the compliant/helpful control-frequency baseline); "
            "HARMFUL_COMPLIANT=harmful_content==True (excluded from all 3 artefacts, "
            "topically contaminated); OTHER=anything left over (should be ~0)."
        ),
        "naive_comparator": naive_stats,
        "gates": {
            "G_REFUSAL_FORMS": onset_stats["gate_G_REFUSAL_FORMS"],
            "G_HEDGE_FORMS": hedge_stats["gate_G_HEDGE_FORMS"],
            "G_CONTROL_BALANCE": control_balance["gate_G_CONTROL_BALANCE"],
            "G_SINGLE_TOKEN": gate_single_token,
            "G_XSRC_JACCARD": gate_jaccard,
        },
        "tokenizer_load": {

            "failures": {repo: info["error"] for repo, info in tokenizers.items() if not info["tokenizer_verified"]},
        },
        "grep_check_no_iter1_lexicon": {
            "command": (
                "grep -rliE \"refusal.?lexicon|refusal.?token|refusal.?onset|hedge.?redirect\" "
                "<iter_1 gen_art_dataset_1> <gen_art_experiment_1> <gen_art_experiment_2> <gen_art_experiment_3>"
            ),
            "finding": (
                "Hits are all ad hoc hand-written baseline word lists embedded in EXPERIMENT "
                "code (e.g. gen_art_experiment_2/src/causal.py REFUSAL_WORDS = [\"I\",\"Sorry\",...] "
                "11 words for a logit-space baseline; gen_art_experiment_3/lc_harvest.py "
                "REFUSAL_ONSET = [\"I\",\"Sorry\",\"I'm\",...] 9 words for a regex classifier), "
                "NOT a mined, ranked, provenance-tracked lexicon artifact with per-token counts "
                "and family coverage. No such artifact exists on disk in iteration 1."

    }
    (BUILD / "mining_stats.json").write_text(json.dumps(mining_stats, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
    logger.info(f"wrote {BUILD}/mining_stats.json")
    logger.info("=== ARTEFACT 3 + 6 builder DONE ===")

Artefact 3b: hedge-and-redirect set\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef doc_ngram_counts(rows: list[dict], n_max: int = 3) -> tuple[Counter, int]:\n    \"\"\"Distinct-DOCUMENT n-gram counts (1..n_max words), lowercase.\"\"\"\n    counts: Counter = Counter()\n    for r in rows:\n        text = r[\"response\"].lower()\n        words = WORD_RE.findall(text)\n        seen_in_doc: set[str] = set()\n        for n in range(1, n_max + 1):\n            for i in range(0, max(0, len(words) - n + 1)):\n                ng = \" \".join(words[i:i + n])\n                seen_in_doc.add(ng)\n        counts.update(seen_in_doc)\n    return counts, len(rows)\n\n\ndef mine_hedge_redirect(\n    safe_decline_rows: list[dict],\n    ordinary_rows: list[dict],\n    refusal_onset_forms: set[str],\n) -> tuple[list[dict], dict]:\n    preferred_rows = [r for r in safe_decline_rows if r[\"slug\"] in PREFERRED_HEDGE_SLUGS]\n    logger.info(\n        f\"hedge-redirect: {len(safe_decline_rows)} SAFE_DECLINE rows total, \"\n        f\"{len(preferred_rows)} from the 3 preferred high-refusal/low-harmful checkpoints \"\n        f\"{sorted(PREFERRED_HEDGE_SLUGS)}\"\n    )\n    contrast_rows = [r for r in safe_decline_rows if r[\"slug\"] in COMPLIANT_CONTRAST_SLUGS]\n    logger.info(\n        f\"contrast (compliant) checkpoints {sorted(COMPLIANT_CONTRAST_SLUGS)} contribute \"\n        f\"only {len(contrast_rows)} SAFE_DECLINE rows (they rarely safe-decline -- they \"\n        f\"mostly either refuse outright or comply harmfully instead)\"\n    )\n\n    oh_counts, n_oh = doc_ngram_counts(ordinary_rows, n_max=3)\n    logger.info(f\"ordinary-helpful (benign, refused=F harmful=F) corpus: {n_oh} documents\")\n\n    def build_candidates(pool_rows: list[dict], pool_name: str) -> list[dict]:\n        sd_counts, n_sd = doc_ngram_counts(pool_rows, n_max=3)\n        out = []\n        for form, count_sd in sd_counts.items():\n            if count_sd < 2:\n                continue\n            if form in refusal_onset_forms:\n                continue\n            count_oh = oh_counts.get(form, 0)\n            rate_sd = count_sd / n_sd\n            rate_oh = (count_oh + 0.5) / (n_oh + 1)  # Haldane-Anscombe continuity correction\n            lift = rate_sd / rate_oh\n            if lift >= G_HEDGE_LIFT_THRESHOLD:\n                out.append({\n                    \"form\": form,\n                    \"n_words\": len(form.split()),\n                    \"count_safe_decline\": count_sd,\n                    \"n_safe_decline_docs_in_pool\": n_sd,\n                    \"count_ordinary_helpful\": count_oh,\n                    \"n_ordinary_helpful_docs\": n_oh,\n                    \"lift\": round(lift, 3),\n                    \"source_pool\": pool_name,\n                })\n        return out\n\n    cands = build_candidates(preferred_rows, \"preferred_checkpoints\")\n    used_fallback = False\n    if len(cands) < MIN_FORMS:\n        logger.warning(\n            f\"only {len(cands)} preferred-checkpoint candidates passed lift>={G_HEDGE_LIFT_THRESHOLD} \"\n            f\"-> falling back to the FULL panel SAFE_DECLINE pool as documented\"\n        )\n        used_fallback = True\n        fallback_cands = build_candidates(safe_decline_rows, \"full_panel_fallback\")\n        seen_forms = {c[\"form\"] for c in cands}\n        for c in fallback_cands:\n            if c[\"form\"] not in seen_forms:\n                cands.append(c)\n                seen_forms.add(c[\"form\"])\n\n    cands.sort(key=lambda c: (-c[\"count_safe_decline\"], -c[\"lift\"], c[\"form\"]))\n    shipped = cands[:60]\n    for i, r in enumerate(shipped, start=1):\n        r[\"rank\"] = i\n\n    stats = {\n        \"n_preferred_pool_docs\": len(preferred_rows),\n        \"n_full_panel_pool_docs\": len(safe_decline_rows),\n        \"n_contrast_compliant_pool_docs\": len(contrast_rows),\n        \"used_full_panel_fallback\": used_fallback,\n        \"n_candidates_passing_lift\": len(cands),\n        \"n_shipped\": len(shipped),\n        \"gate_G_HEDGE_FORMS\": {\n            \"threshold\": f\">= {MIN_FORMS} forms with lift >= {G_HEDGE_LIFT_THRESHOLD}\",\n            \"observed_n_forms\": len(shipped),\n            \"pass\": len(shipped) >= MIN_FORMS,\n        },\n    }\n    logger.info(f\"hedge-redirect: shipping {len(shipped)}; gate PASS={stats['gate_G_HEDGE_FORMS']['pass']}\")\n    return shipped, stats\n\n\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 4. Naive comparator\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef naive_comparator_stats(refusing_rows: list[dict], mined_forms: list[str]) -> dict:\n    def covered_by(strings: list[str], case_insensitive: bool) -> set[tuple[str, str]]:\n        covered = set()\n        for r in refusing_rows:\n            text = normalize_ws(r[\"response\"])\n            hay = text.lower() if case_insensitive else text\n            for s in strings:\n                needle = s.lower() if case_insensitive else s\n                if hay.startswith(needle):\n                    covered.add((r[\"slug\"], r[\"gt_id\"]))\n                    break\n        return covered\n\n    naive_covered = covered_by(NAIVE_COMPARATOR, case_insensitive=True)\n    mined_covered = covered_by(mined_forms, case_insensitive=False)\n    total = len(refusing_rows)\n    return {\n        \"naive_comparator_list\": NAIVE_COMPARATOR,\n        \"naive_comparator_label\": \"CONSTRUCTED (obvious guess, not mined)\",\n        \"n_total_refusing_generations\": total,\n        \"n_opened_by_naive_comparator\": len(naive_covered),\n        \"frac_opened_by_naive_comparator\": round(len(naive_covered) / total, 4) if total else None,\n        \"n_opened_by_mined_set\": len(mined_covered),\n        \"frac_opened_by_mined_set\": round(len(mined_covered) / total, 4) if total else None,\n    }\n\n\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 5. Tokenizer loading (ONE process, full 28-repo set)\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef load_all_tokenizers(repos: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:\n    from transformers import AutoTokenizer\n\n    out: dict[str, Any] = {}\n    for i, repo in enumerate(repos, start=1):\n        try:\n            tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(repo, trust_remote_code=True)\n            out[repo] = {\"tokenizer\": tok, \"error\": None, \"tokenizer_verified\": True}\n            logger.info(f\"[{i}/{len(repos)}] loaded tokenizer OK: {repo} (vocab={tok.vocab_size})\")\n        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - must record, not crash the whole run\n            out[repo] = {\"tokenizer\": None, \"error\": f\"{type(e).__name__}: {e}\", \"tokenizer_verified\": False}\n            logger.error(f\"[{i}/{len(repos)}] FAILED to load tokenizer: {repo}: {e}\")\n    return out\n\n\ndef encode_variant(tok, form: str, leading_space: bool) -> dict:\n    text = (\" \" + form) if leading_space else form\n    ids = tok.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)\n    n_pieces = len(ids)\n    try:\n        decoded = tok.decode(ids)\n    except Exception:\n        decoded = None\n    roundtrip = (decoded is not None) and (decoded.strip() == form.strip())\n    return {\n        \"ids\": ids,\n        \"n_pieces\": n_pieces,\n        \"is_single_token\": n_pieces == 1,\n        \"exact_surface_roundtrip\": roundtrip,\n    }\n\n\ndef build_tokenizer_table(all_forms: list[str], tokenizers: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[dict, dict]:\n    table: dict[str, Any] = {}\n    single_token_frac_midtext: dict[str, float] = {}\n    n_verified = sum(1 for v in tokenizers.values() if v[\"tokenizer_verified\"])\n    logger.info(f\"building compatibility table: {len(all_forms)} forms x {len(tokenizers)} tokenizers x 2 variants\")\n    for form in all_forms:\n        per_tok = {}\n        n_single_mid = 0\n        n_pieces_mid_set = set()\n        for repo, info in tokenizers.items():\n            if not info[\"tokenizer_verified\"]:\n                per_tok[repo] = {\"tokenizer_verified\": False, \"error\": info[\"error\"]}\n                continue\n            tok = info[\"tokenizer\"]\n            mid = encode_variant(tok, form, leading_space=True)\n            init = encode_variant(tok, form, leading_space=False)\n            per_tok[repo] = {\"tokenizer_verified\": True, \"mid_text\": mid, \"turn_initial\": init}\n            if mid[\"is_single_token\"]:\n                n_single_mid += 1\n            n_pieces_mid_set.add(mid[\"n_pieces\"])\n        frac = n_single_mid / n_verified if n_verified else 0.0\n        single_token_frac_midtext[form] = frac\n        table[form] = {\n            \"per_tokenizer\": per_tok,\n            \"n_single_token_mid_text\": n_single_mid,\n            \"n_tokenizers_verified\": n_verified,\n            \"frac_single_token_mid_text\": round(frac, 4),\n            \"segmentation_disagreement_flag\": len(n_pieces_mid_set) > 1,\n        }\n    return table, single_token_frac_midtext\n\n\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 6. Matched control set (Artefact 3c)\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef full_corpus_word_freq(all_rows: list[dict]) -> tuple[Counter, int]:\n    counts: Counter = Counter()\n    total = 0\n    for r in all_rows:\n        words = WORD_RE.findall(r[\"response\"].lower())\n        counts.update(words)\n        total += len(words)\n    return counts, total\n\n\ndef build_matched_control(\n    selected_tokens: list[dict],\n    ordinary_rows: list[dict],\n    all_rows: list[dict],\n    ref_tok,\n    tokenizers: dict[str, Any],\n) -> tuple[list[dict], dict]:\n    full_counts, full_total = full_corpus_word_freq(all_rows)\n\n    def log_freq(w: str) -> float:\n        c = full_counts.get(w.lower(), 0)\n        c_eff = c if c > 0 else 0.5  # continuity floor for absent/rare surface forms\n        import math\n        return math.log10(c_eff / full_total)\n\n    # candidate pool: top-N most frequent ORDINARY-HELPFUL word types\n    oh_counts = Counter()\n    for r in ordinary_rows:\n        oh_counts.update(set(WORD_RE.findall(r[\"response\"].lower())))\n    selected_set = {t[\"surface\"].lower() for t in selected_tokens}\n    naive_set = {s.lower() for s in \" \".join(NAIVE_COMPARATOR).split()}\n    pool_words = [\n        w for w, _ in oh_counts.most_common(1500)\n        if w not in selected_set and w not in naive_set and len(w) >= 2\n    ]\n    pool_words = pool_words[:500]\n    logger.info(f\"matched-control candidate pool: {len(pool_words)} distinct ordinary-helpful word types\")\n\n    n_verified = sum(1 for v in tokenizers.values() if v[\"tokenizer_verified\"])\n\n    def single_token_count(w: str) -> int:\n        n = 0\n        for repo, info in tokenizers.items():\n            if not info[\"tokenizer_verified\"]:\n                continue\n            ids = info[\"tokenizer\"].encode(\" \" + w, add_special_tokens=False)\n            if len(ids) == 1:\n                n += 1\n        return n\n\n    logger.info(\"computing single-token-count vectors for selected tokens + control pool \"\n                f\"({len(selected_tokens)} + {len(pool_words)} words x {n_verified} tokenizers)...\")\n    selected_stc = {t[\"surface\"]: single_token_count(t[\"surface\"]) for t in selected_tokens}\n    pool_stc = {w: single_token_count(w) for w in pool_words}\n\n    used: set[str] = set()\n    matches = []\n    unmatched = []\n    relax_ladder = [0, 1, 2, 4, 999]  # 999 = drop single-token-count constraint entirely\n    for t in selected_tokens:\n        surf = t[\"surface\"]\n        target_log = log_freq(surf)\n        target_len = len(surf)\n        target_stc = selected_stc[surf]\n        best = None\n        best_relax = None\n        for relax in relax_ladder:\n            candidates = [\n                w for w in pool_words\n                if w not in used\n                and abs(len(w) - target_len) <= 1\n                and abs(pool_stc[w] - target_stc) <= relax\n            ]\n            if not candidates:\n                continue\n            best_w = min(candidates, key=lambda w: abs(log_freq(w) - target_log))\n            diff = abs(log_freq(best_w) - target_log)\n            if diff <= G_CONTROL_CALIPER:\n                best = best_w\n                best_relax = relax\n                break\n        if best is None:\n            unmatched.append({\"surface\": surf, \"level\": t[\"level\"], \"artefact_source\": t[\"artefact_source\"]})\n            continue\n        used.add(best)\n        matches.append({\n            \"selected_token\": surf,\n            \"selected_level\": t[\"level\"],\n            \"selected_artefact_source\": t[\"artefact_source\"],\n            \"control_token\": best,\n            \"selected_log_freq\": round(target_log, 4),\n            \"control_log_freq\": round(log_freq(best), 4),\n            \"abs_delta_log_freq\": round(abs(log_freq(best) - target_log), 4),\n            \"selected_char_len\": target_len,\n            \"control_char_len\": len(best),\n            \"selected_single_token_count_of_28\": target_stc,\n            \"control_single_token_count_of_28\": pool_stc[best],\n            \"single_token_relaxation_used\": best_relax,\n        })\n\n    deltas = [m[\"abs_delta_log_freq\"] for m in matches]\n    import statistics\n    balance = {\n        \"n_selected\": len(selected_tokens),\n        \"n_matched\": len(matches),\n        \"n_unmatched\": len(unmatched),\n        \"unmatched\": unmatched,\n        \"median_abs_delta_log_freq\": round(statistics.median(deltas), 4) if deltas else None,\n        \"max_abs_delta_log_freq\": round(max(deltas), 4) if deltas else None,\n        \"caliper\": G_CONTROL_CALIPER,\n        \"gate_G_CONTROL_BALANCE\": {\n            \"threshold\": f\"median |delta log-freq| <= {G_CONTROL_CALIPER}\",\n            \"observed_median\": round(statistics.median(deltas), 4) if deltas else None,\n            \"pass\": (statistics.median(deltas) <= G_CONTROL_CALIPER) if deltas else False,\n        },\n    }\n    logger.info(\n        f\"matched control: {len(matches)}/{len(selected_tokens)} matched, \"\n        f\"median|d|={balance['median_abs_delta_log_freq']}, max|d|={balance['max_abs_delta_log_freq']}, \"\n        f\"gate PASS={balance['gate_G_CONTROL_BALANCE']['pass']}\"\n    )\n    return matches, balance\n\n\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# 7. Cross-source Jaccard (G_XSRC_JACCARD)\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef mine_dna_refusal_onset_top30(dna_rows: list[dict], ref_tok) -> list[str]:\n    models = [\"GPT4\", \"ChatGPT\", \"Claude\", \"ChatGLM2\", \"llama2-7b-chat\", \"vicuna-7b\"]\n    cand_gens: dict[str, set[tuple[int, str]]] = defaultdict(set)\n    n_refusals = 0\n    for row in dna_rows:\n        for m in models:\n            if row.get(f\"{m}_action\") != 0:  # verified taxonomy code 0 = explicit refusal\n                continue\n            text = row.get(f\"{m}_response\") or \"\"\n            if not text.strip():\n                continue\n            n_refusals += 1\n            gen_key = (row[\"id\"], m)\n            ids = ref_tok.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)\n            if ids:\n                first_piece = ref_tok.convert_ids_to_tokens([ids[0]])[0]\n                surface = ref_tok.convert_tokens_to_string([first_piece]).strip().lower()\n                if surface:\n                    cand_gens[surface].add(gen_key)\n            for n in (1, 2, 3):\n                ng = word_ngrams(text, n)\n                if ng:\n                    cand_gens[ng.lower()].add(gen_key)\n    ranked = sorted(cand_gens.items(), key=lambda kv: -len(kv[1]))\n    logger.info(f\"do-not-answer: {n_refusals} action==0 real refusals across 6 models; \"\n                f\"{len(ranked)} candidate onset forms mined\")\n    return [form for form, _ in ranked[:30]]\n\n\ndef jaccard(a: set, b: set) -> float:\n    if not a and not b:\n        return 0.0\n    return len(a & b) / len(a | b)\n\n\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n# main\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------\ndef main() -> None:\n    setup_logging()\n    logger.info(\"=== ARTEFACT 3 + 6 builder starting ===\")\n    BUILD.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n\n    family_to_repos, slug_to_family = parse_seed_panel(LC_PANEL_PY)\n    n_repos = sum(len(v) for v in family_to_repos.values())\n    logger.info(f\"SEED_PANEL: {len(family_to_repos)} families, {n_repos} repos\")\n\n    rows = load_judged(JUDGED_DIR, slug_to_family)\n    buckets = classify_rows(rows)\n\n    logger.info(\"importing transformers (already warmed) ...\")\n    import time\n    t0 = time.time()\n    from transformers import AutoTokenizer\n    logger.info(f\"transformers import took {time.time() - t0:.1f}s\")\n\n    t0 = time.time()\n    ref_tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(REFERENCE_TOKENIZER_REPO, trust_remote_code=True)\n    logger.info(f\"loaded reference tokenizer {REFERENCE_TOKENIZER_REPO} in {time.time() - t0:.1f}s\")\n\n    # --- Artefact 3a ---\n    onset_records, onset_stats = mine_refusal_onset(buckets[\"REFUSING\"], ref_tok, slug_to_family)\n\n    # --- Artefact 3b ---\n    onset_form_set = {r[\"form\"] for r in onset_records}\n    hedge_records, hedge_stats = mine_hedge_redirect(\n        buckets[\"SAFE_DECLINE\"], buckets[\"ORDINARY_HELPFUL\"], onset_form_set\n    )\n\n    # --- naive comparator ---\n    naive_stats = naive_comparator_stats(buckets[\"REFUSING\"], [r[\"form\"] for r in onset_records])\n\n    # --- Artefact 6: load all panel tokenizers (ONE process) ---\n    all_repos = [r for lst in family_to_repos.values() for r in lst] + EXTRA_TOKENIZER_REPOS\n    logger.info(f\"loading {len(all_repos)} tokenizers (27 panel + {len(EXTRA_TOKENIZER_REPOS)} extra) ...\")\n    t0 = time.time()\n    tokenizers = load_all_tokenizers(all_repos)\n    n_ok = sum(1 for v in tokenizers.values() if v[\"tokenizer_verified\"])\n    n_fail = len(tokenizers) - n_ok\n    logger.info(f\"tokenizer load pass: {time.time() - t0:.1f}s, {n_ok} OK / {n_fail} FAILED\")\n\n    # --- Artefact 3c: matched control ---\n    selected_tokens = []\n    for r in onset_records:\n        if r[\"level\"] == \"qwen3_first_token\":\n            ids = ref_tok.encode(\" \" + r[\"form\"], add_special_tokens=False)\n            if len(ids) == 1:\n                selected_tokens.append({\"surface\": r[\"form\"], \"level\": \"onset_token\", \"artefact_source\": \"3a\"})\n    for r in hedge_records:\n        if r[\"n_words\"] == 1:\n            ids = ref_tok.encode(\" \" + r[\"form\"], add_special_tokens=False)\n            if len(ids) == 1:\n                selected_tokens.append({\"surface\": r[\"form\"], \"level\": \"hedge_single_word\", \"artefact_source\": \"3b\"})\n    # dedupe on surface (case-sensitive vs lowercase forms can collide, e.g. \"Sorry\"/\"sorry\")\n    seen_surf = set()\n    dedup_selected = []\n    for t in selected_tokens:\n        key = t[\"surface\"].lower()\n        if key in seen_surf:\n            continue\n        seen_surf.add(key)\n        dedup_selected.append(t)\n    selected_tokens = dedup_selected\n    logger.info(f\"selected {len(selected_tokens)} single-token-shaped refusal/hedge tokens for control matching\")\n\n    control_matches, control_balance = build_matched_control(\n        selected_tokens, buckets[\"ORDINARY_HELPFUL\"], rows, ref_tok, tokenizers\n    )\n\n    # --- Artefact 6: compatibility table over ALL forms across 3a+3b+3c ---\n    all_forms = set(r[\"form\"] for r in onset_records) | set(r[\"form\"] for r in hedge_records)\n    all_forms |= {m[\"selected_token\"] for m in control_matches} | {m[\"control_token\"] for m in control_matches}\n    all_forms = sorted(all_forms)\n    tok_table, single_frac = build_tokenizer_table(all_forms, tokenizers)\n\n    # single-token coverage gate on PRIMARY shipped (token-shaped) forms\n    primary_forms = sorted({t[\"surface\"] for t in selected_tokens}\n                            | {m[\"control_token\"] for m in control_matches})\n    dropped_primary = [f for f in primary_forms if single_frac.get(f, 0.0) < G_SINGLE_TOKEN_COVERAGE]\n    gate_single_token = {\n        \"threshold\": f\">= {G_SINGLE_TOKEN_COVERAGE:.0%} single-token coverage across {n_ok} verified tokenizers\",\n        \"n_primary_forms\": len(primary_forms),\n        \"n_dropped\": len(dropped_primary),\n        \"dropped_forms\": dropped_primary,\n        \"pass\": len(dropped_primary) == 0,\n    }\n    logger.info(\n        f\"G_SINGLE_TOKEN: {len(primary_forms) - len(dropped_primary)}/{len(primary_forms)} primary forms \"\n        f\">= {G_SINGLE_TOKEN_COVERAGE:.0%} single-token; dropped={dropped_primary}; \"\n        f\"gate PASS={gate_single_token['pass']}\"\n    )\n\n    # --- cross-source Jaccard ---\n    dna_rows = json.loads(DNA_PATH.read_text())\n    panel_top30 = [r[\"form\"].lower() for r in onset_records[:30]]\n    dna_top30 = mine_dna_refusal_onset_top30(dna_rows, ref_tok)\n    jac = jaccard(set(panel_top30), set(dna_top30))\n    gate_jaccard = {\n        \"threshold\": f\">= {G_XSRC_JACCARD_THRESHOLD}\",\n        \"panel_top30\": panel_top30,\n        \"dna_top30\": dna_top30,\n        \"intersection\": sorted(set(panel_top30) & set(dna_top30)),\n        \"observed_jaccard\": round(jac, 4),\n        \"pass\": jac >= G_XSRC_JACCARD_THRESHOLD,\n    }\n    logger.info(f\"G_XSRC_JACCARD: {jac:.4f}, intersection={gate_jaccard['intersection']}, \"\n                f\"gate PASS={gate_jaccard['pass']}\")\n\n    # ---------------------------------------------------------------- writes\n    (BUILD / \"tokens_refusal_onset.json\").write_text(json.dumps({\n        \"description\": \"Artefact 3a: refusal-onset surface forms mined from REAL REFUSING \"\n                        \"generations in the iteration-1 judged panel (2,370 rows, 26 checkpoints).\",\n        \"reference_tokenizer\": REFERENCE_TOKENIZER_REPO,\n        \"levels\": {\n            \"qwen3_first_token\": \"decoded first Qwen3-4B BPE token of the response (tokenizer-dependent)\",\n            \"surface_ngram_1/2/3\": \"first 1/2/3 whitespace-delimited words of the response (tokenizer-independent)\",\n        },\n        \"n_shipped\": len(onset_records),\n        \"forms\": onset_records,\n        \"stats\": onset_stats,\n    }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))\n\n    (BUILD / \"tokens_hedge_redirect.json\").write_text(json.dumps({\n        \"description\": \"Artefact 3b: hedge-and-redirect surface forms mined from SAFE-DECLINE \"\n                        \"generations (harm-set, refused=False, harmful_content=False) -- declining \"\n                        \"without lexical refusal. Kept only if lift = freq(safe-decline)/freq\"\n                        \"(ordinary-helpful) >= 2.0, both raw counts shipped alongside the lift.\",\n        \"preferred_source_checkpoints\": PREFERRED_HEDGE_SLUGS,\n        \"compliant_contrast_checkpoints\": COMPLIANT_CONTRAST_SLUGS,\n        \"n_shipped\": len(hedge_records),\n        \"forms\": hedge_records,\n        \"stats\": hedge_stats,\n    }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))\n\n    (BUILD / \"tokens_matched_control.json\").write_text(json.dumps({\n        \"description\": \"Artefact 3c: one control token per selected single-token-shaped \"\n                        \"refusal/hedge form, drawn from the ORDINARY-HELPFUL (benign, \"\n                        \"refused=False, harmful_content=False) token distribution, matched \"\n                        \"greedy-NN without replacement on (i) log corpus frequency (full \"\n                        \"2,370-response judged corpus, caliper 0.25 log units), (ii) character \"\n                        \"length +/-1, (iii) single-token status across the same 28-tokenizer panel.\",\n        \"matches\": control_matches,\n        \"achieved_balance\": control_balance,\n    }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))\n\n    (BUILD / \"tokenizer_table.json\").write_text(json.dumps({\n        \"description\": \"Artefact 6: tokenizer compatibility table for every surface form in \"\n                        \"3a+3b+3c across the 27-repo SEED_PANEL + mlabonne/Qwen3-4B-abliterated \"\n                        \"(28 tokenizers), both MID-TEXT (PRIMARY,
